questions.question: What does David lift up to the LORD in Psalm 25?
Whom does the LORD instruct in his way?
options: The wealthy and those who give freely
The mighty and those who rule nations
The wise and those who study the law
The humble and those who fear him
questions.answer: The humble and those who fear him
